Extra read-only folders you may use: handoff-docs, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fqq-Desktop-Topflightapps-roundai/2a408671-6ff1-4104-9d24-9f97da7d0ee6/scratchpad/cr/review-evidence

Scenario TC-07/S24 — Human review: the task screen matches the prototype minus Email Tasks, and Email Tasks is gone as functionality, not just hidden

Requirements it checks:
- T1: Design and functionality match the source-of-truth prototype RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html, except Email Tasks (AC 11 and the 2026-09-24 comment win)
- U9: 'Email Tasks' is absent from the task screen: the button and the functionality, not just unused
- U7: The task list can be sent to another signed-in app user (an NP or covering physician) in-app only, through the Handoff delivery (same recipient picker, same in-app delivery), never by email

Given: RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html (TFA-92585 attachment, 2026-09-25), the app's task screens, the task screens' code (TasksOverlay, routes/snf/Tasks, tasksExport, handoffs send), convex/email.ts and the built bundle
When: Compare layout, grouping, labels, completed section and Copy Text output side by side; review what Copy Text and Send can call; watch network requests while pressing them
Then: Matches the prototype; the prototype's Email Tasks is absent in the app (AC 11 wins); Send, the visit on completed tasks and the completed grouping are judged against the AC text and the current app UI (Q13). No mailto, email-send action, Web Share or Capacitor Share is reachable from the task screens; convex/email.ts only sends sign-in codes; the task screen's bundle has no 'Email Tasks' string; Copy Text and Send make no request other than to the app's own backend
Oracle: Human side-by-side review (AC 1) and code + HAR review (AC 11 'confirmed absent, not just unused')

THE ORACLE WINS. The question below only scopes this scenario to what code can decide. If the question, or its pass/fail rule, ever reads differently from the Then/Oracle above, follow the Then/Oracle, give the verdict the oracle gives, and say where they differ in openQuestions.

- (none)

Gaps the matrix already records (use the id in a label only when the finding is exactly that gap):
- (none)

YOUR QUESTION (answer this, from the code):
From the task screens (src: TasksOverlay, the Nursing Home Tasks route, tasksExport / task copy helpers, the handoff Send used for tasks): is any mailto:, email-send action, navigator.share (Web Share) or @capacitor/share reachable; is there any 'Email Tasks' control in the task screen code; does convex/email.ts (and every sendEmail call) send anything other than sign-in codes; do Copy Text and Send call anything other than the clipboard and the app's own Convex functions? The static bundle grep is in the staticEvidence file (shareAndEmailSource / shareAndEmailBundle).

pass = no mailto, email-send action, Web Share or Capacitor Share is reachable from the task screens, no 'Email Tasks' control exists, convex/email.ts only sends sign-in codes, and Copy Text and Send call only the clipboard and the app's own backend
fail = any of these is present
